public_rationale: The record supports a shared research direction and substantial contemporary limitations. Anthropic studied agentic coding, Google researchers built a web agent, and Meta researchers developed an assistant benchmark. These are related activities, but they do not establish that all three were developing the specified research capability in July 2024. Nor do measured failures prove a limitation inherent in every LLM. Partial web-agent successes do not refute a claim about reliable deep research.
